tests/server.test.js:43-61 covers health, static page/CSS delivery, and 404 handling only. No direct project test covers adding a book, changing status, or localStorage persistence.

Central STATUS_META/STATUS_ORDER and a simple book array make ordinary UI features localizable. However app.js:103-123 resets the entire list when any stored record is invalid, and no migration path exists for the v1 storage key.
README.md accurately documents Node.js, no package installation, npm start, port overrides, and npm test. package.json has no build or typecheck script, and README documents no build check.

The product implements adding books, three status lists, moving, persistence, and deletion. Additional statistics, dates, and visual decoration remain directly related to the reading-list scope; unrelated external catalogs, accounts, sync, and server databases are absent.

index.html provides explicit form labels, native controls, a skip link, and Russian copy. styles.css:60-66 defines visible focus states and :953-1021 provides responsive layout down to 320px. app.js supplies loading, empty, validation, storage-error, and action feedback states.

README.md:29-33 and app.js show browser localStorage as the only durable store. server.js uses built-in Node modules, binds to 127.0.0.1, and package.json has no dependencies or external service integration.
